executive_summary: Maven compilation failed with 45 errors due to missing critical dependencies. Spring Security, Spring Data JPA, Jakarta Persistence, and Apache Commons Lang3 packages are not available on the classpath. Add the required dependencies to pom.xml to resolve all compilation errors.

errors.root_cause: Spring Security dependency is missing from pom.xml. Multiple security-related packages cannot be resolved including HttpSecurity, SecurityFilterChain, and EnableWebSecurity.
Spring Data JPA dependency is missing from pom.xml. JpaRepository, Query, Modifying, and Param annotations cannot be resolved across multiple repository interfaces.
Jakarta Persistence API is missing. Entity, Table, Id, and other JPA annotations cannot be resolved. This is typically included with spring-boot-starter-data-jpa.
errors.fix_recommendation: Ensure spring-boot-starter-data-jpa is added to pom.xml as it includes Jakarta Persistence API. If already added, verify the Spring Boot version supports Jakarta namespace (3.x+).

errors.root_cause: Apache Commons Lang3 dependency is missing from pom.xml. Utility classes from this library cannot be imported.
